audio_invalid.name: audio_invalid
audio_invalid.long_description: The specified audio codec is invalid or not recognized by the system.

audio_aac.name: aac
audio_aac.long_description: Encodes or decodes audio using the Advanced Audio Codec (AAC) format, widely used for high-quality audio compression.

audio_mp3.name: mp3
audio_mp3.long_description: Encodes or decodes audio using the MP3 format, a common lossy audio compression standard.

audio_opus.name: opus
audio_opus.long_description: Encodes or decodes audio using the Opus format, optimized for interactive speech and music transmission over the internet.

audio_flac.name: flac
audio_flac.long_description: Encodes or decodes audio using the Free Lossless Audio Codec (FLAC), preserving the original audio quality without loss.

audio_vorbis.name: vorbis
audio_vorbis.long_description: Encodes or decodes audio using the Vorbis format, an open-source lossy audio compression format.

audio_pcm.name: pcm
audio_pcm.long_description: Represents uncompressed Pulse Code Modulation (PCM) audio data for high-quality sound without compression.
